authority: owner delegated the decisions to the agent ('nach wissenschaftlicher Praxis selbst entscheiden'); committed before any test episode and before validation tuning v2

O1_channel_fairness.change: EvidenceId.episode, frame ids, message bytes and per-frame loss keys use protocol.transport_id(building, replicate), a method- and cell-neutral key of fixed length, instead of the episode id that named method and config
O1_channel_fairness.consequence: validation tuning is rerun as v2 with the unchanged grid, budget and selection rule; the calibration pilot is rerun as v2 with the v2 selection; v1 results stay committed and superseded, never mixed
O1_channel_fairness.reason: frame length and drop draws depended on the method name (repair about 2 % more frames than dynamics_ids under the byte budget); the v1 control margin (0.001) is smaller than this bias

O2_failure_rule.decision: keep the preregistered rule as primary
O2_failure_rule.primary: probes answered before the failure tick keep their loss; every later probe gets the loss of the default decision 'closed' against the true exogenous state
O2_failure_rule.sensitivity_added: spec M6 rule: maximal request loss (4) for every probe after the failure tick; plus pairs with any failure excluded (already preregistered)
O2_failure_rule.invalid_status: runner status 'invalid' (ImpossibleEvidence) is an episode failure under the primary rule
O2_failure_rule.invalid_scenario: a building whose scenario cannot be regenerated, fails validation or has an empty coverage target set is replaced by the next unused entry of the same list and family
O2_failure_rule.reason: the frozen rule must not be changed after calibration data showed its effect; the stricter spec rule is reported, not chosen afterwards

O3_coverage.decision: primary coverage for the H2 claim = final coverage at the horizon of the target set 'closed' (grid cells free with every passage closed, fixed before the run)
O3_coverage.estimand: relative coverage loss = 1 - mean_b Cov_candidate / mean_b Cov_control, cells weighted equally, families 50/50, same paired cluster bootstrap as the gain; claim needs its upper CI bound <= 0.05
O3_coverage.secondary: time-averaged coverage (AUC) and the target set 'open'
O3_coverage.reason: spec M6 defines coverage as the share of fixed free target cells seen at least once; AUC is listed there as additional

O4_infrastructure.decision: a hard-timeout kill or a crash of the worker process is an infrastructure event: kept in infra.jsonl, the batch stops, the cause is checked, the episode reruns with the same seeds
O4_infrastructure.repeat: a key killed a second time is a reproducible hang and becomes a failure row with every probe defaulted to 'closed' (failure tick 0)
O4_infrastructure.breaker_rows: rows written before the breaker trips stay results; only if the cause is shown to be infrastructure (disk, import, host) are they quarantined with a logged reason and rerun

O5_sensitivity.losses: 2:1 and 3:1 by re-scoring the recorded probabilities with the matching decision threshold (decision-level sensitivity); policies keep 4:1; labelled as such
O5_sensitivity.rho_0_1: separate frozen batch after the primary batch with its own budget approval; not part of the primary GO
O5_sensitivity.reason: keeps the primary batch within budget; a policy-level loss sensitivity would need a re-tuning per loss ratio

O6_definitions.js: Jensen-Shannon between candidate and H2-control probabilities on the same probe (same building, cell, replicate, tick, robot, passage)
O6_definitions.repair_lag: per (robot, passage) on that robot's probes of the passage after each true change, threshold 0.8, 3 consecutive probes, censored by the next change or the horizon; Kaplan-Meier and restricted mean, censoring rate reported
O6_definitions.h1: interaction contrasts primary for the candidate, also reported for the H2 control; other methods descriptive
O6_definitions.pair: (building, cell, replicate) of candidate and H2 control
O6_definitions.runtime: per-episode wall and CPU quantiles; per-decision policy runtime is not recorded (limitation)

O7_b_reading.decision: sigma_Delta on the gain scale (delta-method influence of the ratio gain), larger of pooled and family-stratified
O7_b_reading.reason: the claim threshold (0.10) and the CI width (0.05) are on the gain scale; the absolute loss difference has another scale

O8_budget.approval: the owner approves the test budget separately; recommendation from the measured cost model with 15 % headroom
O8_budget.truncation: if a cap stops the batch before B, the analysis uses the largest even prefix completed in both lists; below 60 the result is 'inconclusive by design'; never topped up
